notes.title: Biolab Wars DX: Important update on the way!
notes.content:
[b]Attention! Biolab Wars will receive an important update soon![/b]

We are planning a major update, including the following improvements:
[list]
[*]Shooting in 8 directions!
[*]Ammunition rebalancing;
[*]More bullets!
[*]Decrease in knockback;
[*]New stage between the last miniboss and the final boss.
[*]...and other minor improvements.
[/list]
All of this will be available for [b]free to everyone who already owns the game.[/b]

[b]But be aware:  on April 20th, the price of Biolab Wars will be adjusted.[/b]

Therefore, you can still buy it at the current price until April 20th. Take advantage of it!

[i]Q: Why is there going to be a price adjustment?[/i]
A: With the arrival of Wild Dogs, we believe that more people will look for Biolab Wars. Therefore, we decided to invest in significant improvements.

[i]Q: I already own the game, do I need to pay anything extra for these improvements?[/i]
A: No! You don't need to pay anything extra. The improvements will be free for everyone who already owns the game.

[i]Q: Will I still have access to the old version?[/i]
A: Yes! You will have two versions of Biolab Wars to play whenever you want.

notes.title: Patch Notes (2023-04-01)
Boss Rush mode is here!
notes.content:
Hey friends, a new free update is available:

Choose your mercenary, equip the ammunition of your choice and kill the bosses in the shortest time possible!

It's time to put your name in the Mercenary Hall of Fame with the new Boss Rush Leaderboard!

HURRAH!

notes.title: A new mercenary is coming!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey, guys![/b][/h1]

In celebration of the launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232810/Savage_Halloween/][i][b]Savage Halloween[/b][/i][/url],  new playable character is available for free in Biolab Wars to help fight the gooey aliens.

[h2][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]

* [u] New Character[/u]: [b]Jack[/b] - Another experiment in the alien laboratory, but this time with vegetables! Jack joins the mercenary team to try to rid the land of his captors, and perhaps enjoy Halloween for the first time.

[h3][i][b]Happy Halloween![/b][/i][/h3]
